# Blackout Maps

> Free offline emergency maps for when the network goes down. Find water, medical care and supplies, and a route to reach them. No account and no charge. The maps work after they are downloaded. Guides, supply links and videos are extras.

The maps do not use GPS. You set your position. Portugal is included on first launch. Other places are added from Settings.

## Free maps

- [Blackout Maps](https://blackoutmaps.com/): the site. The free offline maps are the product.
- [Map in the browser](https://blackoutmaps.com/maps/): the same map, with no install.
- Android is free. iOS is not in the App Store yet. There is no public Play Store URL on the site.

## Guides

Paid illustrated PDFs. The files are not public. Prices below are the shelf prices in euros. Three guides are 15% off. All eight are 50% off.

- [All guides](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides.html)
- [Power in a Blackout](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/power-in-a-blackout.html): €9.80. What to do when the lights go out, and how to size backup power for your home: power banks, stations, generators and solar, with worked examples.
- [Water When the Tap Stops](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/water-when-the-tap-stops.html): €7.80. How much water to store, how to make it safe with boiling, bleach or a filter, and how to cope for a week when the tap stops.
- [Food Without Power](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/food-without-power.html): €7.40. What to eat first when the power goes, a no-cook pantry that keeps, and how to cook safely without electricity.
- [The Go-Bag and Leaving Home](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/the-go-bag-and-leaving-home.html): €7.80. When to stay and when to leave, what to grab in ten minutes, how to pack a go-bag and how to find your family when phones fail.
- [First Aid When Help Is Slow](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/first-aid-when-help-is-slow.html): €9.40. Illustrated emergency cards for CPR, bleeding, choking and burns, and how to care for someone for hours when help is slow.
- [Staying Informed and in Touch](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/staying-informed-and-in-touch.html): €8.20. Reliable news, family contact and calls for help when phones, internet and power fail: radios, walkie-talkies and a plan that needs no signal.
- [Fire, Gas and a Safe Home](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/fire-gas-and-a-safe-home.html): €7.00. What to do in a fire, gas leak or carbon monoxide alarm, and how to keep candles, heaters and batteries safe in an outage.
- [Warm, Cool and Sheltered](https://blackoutmaps.com/guides/warm-cool-and-sheltered.html): €7.40. How to keep people safe in a cold or hot home without power, set up a warm room and a cool room, and shelter from storms and smoke.

## Supplies

Suggestions with Amazon links. Blackout Maps earns a commission. The price is Amazon's price.

- [Supplies](https://blackoutmaps.com/buying-guide.html)

## Videos

Beginner lessons. Each one plays from YouTube only after a click.

- [Videos](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html)
- [Power](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#power): Electricity, meters, a multimeter, power stations and charging.
- [Heating](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#heating): Staying warm indoors, safe heat, blankets and layers.
- [Food](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#food): Finding food, what to cook, cooking off-grid, and food that keeps.
- [Building](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#building): Shelters, tents, tarps, knots and repairs.
- [Water](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#water): Storing, filtering and treating drinking water.
- [First aid](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#first-aid): A basic kit, bleeding, cuts, burns and sprains.
- [Communication](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#communication): Two-way radios, a weather radio and a family plan.
- [Light](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#light): Headlamps, flashlights and lanterns.
- [Sanitation](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#sanitation): A toilet and washing when the taps are off.
- [Go-bag](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#go-bag): What to pack, and how to pack it.
- [Home](https://blackoutmaps.com/prep-academy.html#home): The first hours of a blackout, utilities and a small fire.
